# iosxe_card (Data Source)

This data source can read the Card configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_card" "example" {
  card_type = "t1"
  slot      = 0
  bay       = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bay` (Number)
- `card_type` (String)
- `slot` (Number)

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
